mapper.select: SELECT comment_id::TEXT AS db_key, bbs_id, context, good_cnt, bad_cnt, reg_id, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = t_comment.reg_id) AS reg_nm, TO_CHAR(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_comment WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND bbs_id = #{bbsId}::integer ORDER BY comment_id
SELECT comment_id::TEXT AS db_key, bbs_id, context, reg_id FROM t_comment WHERE comment_id = #{dbKey}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_comment (bbs_id, context, good_cnt, bad_cnt, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{bbsId}::integer, #{context}, 0, 0, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_comment SET context = #{context}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE comment_id = #{dbKey}::integer
UPDATE t_comment SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE comment_id = #{dbKey}::integer
